profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer at Emerson Automation Solutions
profile.summary:
Experienced Full Stack Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the industrial automation industry. Skilled in C#, Angular, SQL and Visual Basic. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's Degree focused in Computer Science from North Dakota State University.

Also has experience using creative graphics editing software such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Premiere Pro.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Conducted several NPD projects and led a team of engineers to update roughly 30+ applications that read, write and verify products, while maintaining correspondence with various internal teams to ensure the work was delivered properly and on time
- Created modernized API for legacy system interoperability that would leverage functionality to increase developer velocity and reduce redundant work
positions.insights: Leading Development Teams and Engineering Leadership

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the development effort for a high-priority application for preconditioning products, which included tasks such as planning, delegating and developing, all in the span of two weeks
- Performed a mass migration of roughly 100+ TFSVC and TFS-Git projects over to GitLab in order to increase workforce productivity and collaboration (both domestic and global), leveraging the new features such as merge requests, pipelines, etc.
- Educated teams abroad at Beijing in order to help train about various topics such as RabbitMQ, newer web technologies and an updated standard software release process
- Led the initiative to create a documentation culture by generating a substantial amount of content (over 150+ pages) for our in-house wiki, and helped to encourage the team to do the same
- Managed a monthly forum where people would present about new technologies or current happenings in the tech world
- Troubleshooted production issues for a wide variety of circumstances at various levels such as hardware, client, server and database

positions.title: Software Project Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, created and implemented a globally-used, user-friendly and responsive application to ensure products met quality specifications that processes ~20k parts per year
- Managed and improved production software necessary for continually processing parts for external customers

positions.title: Graphics Coordinator
positions.description:
- Designed and created posters and graphics for weekly events, using a variety of file types and themes
- Worked in a timely and efficient manner in order to fulfill requests
- Interacted directly with audiences at events
- Performed duties at events such as setting up,  supervising, tearing down, cleaning up and
- Contributed ideas for themes for future events

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Created and designed a C# application used on Emerson's manufacturing line to replace a legacy PHP/Javascript web application and made it more user friendly
- Created and designed a C++ application to help test and debug issues with temperature sensors.

positions.title: Concession Stand Worker
positions.description:
- Worked in a high-stress and fast-paced environment 
- Cooperated with a team of employees to create a positive atmosphere while keeping up team morale
- Provided excellent customer service while doing tasks such as cashiering or preparing food and beverages

positions.title: Water Safety Instructor Assistant
positions.description:
- Planned swimming lesson curricula for 1st-3rd graders
- Supervised a class of roughly 10 children while being in a potentially dangerous environment
- Stepped up and took on the role of a Water Safety Instructor while only having the role of a Water Safety Instructor Assistant

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts Of America · May 2008
